### Load packages and data

```{r load-packages, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse) 
library(tibble)
```

### Exercises 16-17

We set up the data frame. Edit the data below to include information about your team members.

```{r setup-tibble}
team_data <- tibble(
  name = c("Peter Rabbit", "Juliet", "Ethan", 
           "Miles", "Freddy"),
  github_username = c("mcgregors-garden", "juleshevlin-oss", "EWallis08", "Milesmiller100636", "Fredrusson"), 
  colour = c("powderblue", "purple", "green", 
             "gray", "lightblue"),
  hobby = c("Hopping", "crochet", "sport", 
            "golf", "golf"),
  favourite_number = c(2, sample(10, size=1), 4, 26, 10)
  )

team_data
```

### Exercise 18

We now work on visualising our data. 

```{r bar-plot}
p1 <- ggplot(data = team_data, 
             mapping = aes(x = github_username, 
                           y = favourite_number,
                           fill = colour), 
             ) +
   geom_col() +
   scale_fill_identity()
p1
```

Plot shows each person's favourite number iin their favourite colour.
